the severity of abnormal phenotypes induced by the overproduction of tobacco KNOTTED-like homeodomain proteins is determined by the synergistic action between the conserved KNOX and ELK homeodomains, that the severity of morphologies induced by the KNOX domains is determined by the amphipathic nature of the α-helix in the KNOK domains, and that the severity of phenotypes is determined by the C-terminal region of the ELK homeodomains.

the KNOX domains, which are conserved among the plant KNOX family, are important for the specific activity of the homeodomain proteins.
